verdict.rationale: Training-data opt-out is a fair question for an AI coding agent, so the axis applies. However, no evidence item documents a setting, policy, or guarantee that code and prompts are excluded from model training. A probe mentions a 'data-handling policy' in llms.txt but gives none of its contents, and bringing your own or self-hosted models is an adjacent workaround rather than a documented opt-out.
